notes.title: Sakurakreuz is added as Chapter 3
notes.content:
Guten Tag, playtest volunteers. In this update, we have added Sakurakreuz as Chapter 3 in the campaign.

Sakurakreuz drops explosive yellow crosses. If not destroyed by the player, they will explode and spawn smaller mobs which will fly along the 4 axis, forming a grid of dangerous blockades. But do not worry, the smaller mobs will do harmless auto-destruction in a few seconds.

Since Act III, Sakurakreuz may summon a giant black cross which descends slowly and becomes larger over time. If you manage to destroy all 5 parts of the giant black cross, you will get a holy shield lasting a few seconds, which can destroy all non-boss mobs it touches. Use it to eliminate the smaller black crosses that were spawned during the descending of the giant black cross.

Let us know how do you like playing the game. Thanks for all feedback.
